hypothesis: Holdout replication of frontline-classes-wave-2-movement-factorial-v1 on the two seeds revealed from commitment 753d6a5d47ac9e658827821e9f4aa900c7cf89db31e205e7f77153e778abef98 after the main-seed analysis was committed (DECISIONS #157). Replication targets: the class-payoff-spread ordering across arms (facing-locked smallest), the sign of every cross-class arm-level mean payoff, bulwark-mirror decisiveness highest under facing-locked, the rotation-tax ordering, and the bend-share decline under coupling.
